description: OMOP CDM v5.4 PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE table — records of activities or processes ordered or carried out by a healthcare provider for the purposes of diagnosing or treating a patient.

fields.label: Procedure Occurrence ID
fields.description: A system-generated unique identifier for each procedure occurrence.

fields.label: Person ID
fields.description: A foreign key identifier to the person who is subjected to the procedure. The demographic details of that person are stored in the PERSON table.

fields.label: Procedure Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key that refers to a standard procedure concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies.

fields.label: Procedure Date
fields.description: The date on which the procedure was performed.

fields.label: Procedure Datetime
fields.description: The date and time on which the procedure was performed.

fields.label: Procedure End Date
fields.description: The date on which the procedure finished.

fields.label: Procedure End Datetime
fields.description: The date and time on which the procedure finished.

fields.label: Procedure Type Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies reflecting the type of source data from which the procedure record is derived.

fields.label: Modifier Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to a standard concept identifier for a modifier to the procedure (e.g. bilateral).

fields.label: Quantity
fields.description: The quantity of procedures ordered or administered.

fields.label: Provider ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the provider in the provider table who was responsible for carrying out the procedure.

fields.label: Visit Occurrence ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the visit in the visit_occurrence table during which the procedure was carried out.

fields.label: Visit Detail ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the visit in the visit_detail table during which the procedure was carried out.

fields.label: Procedure Source Value
fields.description: The source code for the procedure as it appears in the source data. This code is mapped to a standard procedure concept in the Standardized Vocabularies and the original code is stored here for reference.

fields.label: Procedure Source Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to a procedure concept that refers to the code used in the source.

fields.label: Modifier Source Value
fields.description: The source code for the qualifier as it appears in the source data.
